```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  as_tibble()

metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    launch_date_parsed = as.Date(
      parse_date_time(launch_date, orders = c("ymd", "Bdy"))
    )
  )

categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet") |>
  as_tibble()

crypto <- prices |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(categories, by = "category_id", suffix = c("", "_category"))
```
